note: P4149 (Pro 20:27) — the spirit of man is the lamp of the LORD, searching all his innermost parts.

dims.v: conscience — the God-lit lamp searching the inner depths
the spirit/conscience of man, which is the LORD's lamp, searching out all the innermost parts of a person
the God-given inner light that illumines and probes the depths of the self

neshamah (breath/spirit) — 'the SPIRIT of man is the lamp of the LORD, searching all his innermost parts'; the human spirit/conscience is God's searchlight within, illuminating and probing the deepest self. A profound word on the conscience — God's lamp in the inner being, from which nothing is hidden (cf 20:12; 21:2).
